date_convention: The vendor daily-factor-return row date is preserved as the source session label; it is not treated as a publication timestamp or exact return-period-end timestamp.
scaling_convention: The school ingestion multiplies raw return by 100; sf_quant.load_factors documents and returns factor returns in percent, so regression preparation divides by 100.
limitations: Date labels do not verify publication clock time.
Revision and vintage history are unavailable.
Observed factor rows are not an independently verified complete US exchange calendar.
This mode is retrospective sensitivity analysis, not point-in-time forecasting evidence.
